name: Strong Electric Latch Rune OLD
source: Pathfinder Society Scenario #3-06: Struck by Shadows
description: An invisible rune imprinted on a door latch releases a powerful electric discharge.
disable: DC 23 Thievery (expert) to scratch out the rune without allowing electricity to flow, or Dispel Magic (3rd rank; counteract DC 21) to counteract the rune

generalAbilities.name: Electrocution
generalAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature grasps the door latch directly or with a tool.

Effect The trap deals (3d12+8) Electricity Damage damage to the triggering creature (Basic DC 25 Reflex Saving Throw save).
